coinbase_national_trust_company.entity_scope: National trust company providing fiduciary digital-asset custody; not an insured full-service commercial bank.

gross_mint_redeem_flows.caveat: Gross Circle Mint activity, not a direct measure of XRP demand or a complete bridge to period-end USDC supply.

distribution_economics.formula_summary: Coinbase's allocation is based on USDC held on Coinbase relative to USDC held through other distribution partners after issuer retention; the agreement also allocates half of the remaining amount to broader ecosystem growth after payments to eligible third-party distribution partners.
distribution_economics.caveat: Do not simplify the contract to a blanket 50% of gross reserve income.

network_scale.caveat: Issuer-defined meaningful wallets and market share; not unique verified users or transaction value.

new_circle_distribution_rail.executed_or_announced: Eligible institutional clients can directly mint and redeem USDC through DBS; the arrangement supports 24/7 USD-USDC settlement for minting/redemption.
new_circle_distribution_rail.issuer: Circle's regulated affiliates remain the USDC issuers; DBS is the bank access and settlement channel, not the issuer.
new_circle_distribution_rail.competitive_implication: A direct bank route into Circle issuance/redemption is a competing institutional dollar-stablecoin access path; it is not evidence of XRP adoption.

worldbank_circle_competitive_rail.model: Intermediated/interoperable USDC payment and disbursement pathway alongside existing correspondent banking rails.
